## Test plan

- `pnpm typecheck` ->

## Size

The review budget is about 400 authored lines. Past it, say where the bulk is and why it belongs in one PR.

## Checklist

Do not check a box without evidence for it.

- [ ] Linked issue
- [ ] Exactly one type checked
- [ ] Conventional commit messages
- [ ] `Docs:` line in every commit (the doc changed in the same commit, or `none - <reason>`)
- [ ] `Risk:` line in every commit
- [ ] Docs gate green
- [ ] Tests green
- [ ] CI `verify` green
